text.aria-label: Title text 'Injected load-shift in the lag inputs only: -30% of capacity for 30 days, March 2026 The target stays clean, so the observed power (black) is also the NRA. Grey: C0 median and q05-q95 band. Orange: C2 median and band. Grey shade: the injected shift (it began before the plotted window if the x axis starts above 0). Sky-blue bar along the bottom: gate on or held.'
text.tspan: Injected load-shift in the lag inputs only: -30% of capacity for 30 days, March 2026
The target stays clean, so the observed power (black) is also the NRA. Grey: C0 median and q05-q95 band. Orange: C2 median and band.
Grey shade: the injected shift (it began before the plotted window if the x axis starts above 0). Sky-blue bar along the bottom: gate on or held.
